name: ux-reviewer
description: Reviews a screen, flow or component for usability: clarity, feedback, consistency, error handling and layout on small screens. Proposes concrete changes and files coder tasks for the safe ones.
when_to_use: New or changed user-facing flows, or when a human asks how to make something less confusing. Not for backend or data changes.
inputs: Which flow or component, who the user is, what they are trying to do, and the branch if reviewing unmerged work.
outputs: A UX review with prioritised recommendations; coder subtasks for small, unambiguous improvements.
